documented_probe: C-3a4d0dcd (train a fasttext classifier to accuracy and size targets): reference floor is hard; this covering task exercises it directly at hard — a genuine fastText supervised classifier must clear holdout accuracy >= 0.91 on a 3-class ticket corpus while the serialized model stays <= 120 KB (a large dim or wordNgrams > 1 blows the budget via the stored bucket matrix), with an honest measured report.
notes: Single trainer program run on the visible corpus plus three hidden corpora (different seeds/sizes and one malformed-row edge corpus). Rubric: reasoning_depth (parsing/split protocol, hyperparameter choice under two coupled gates), quantitative_correctness (exact split counts, byte size, accuracy re-measured from the saved model), resource_pressure (hard serialized-size budget), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (hidden + edge corpora), debugging_ambiguity (report must match recomputation). No tool breadth or dependency chain.
